diaspora_bullets: A Patna educator honoured by CGC Group, one of Japan's leading business groups
Free IIT coaching for students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds
news_summary: Super 30 founder Anand Kumar has received a Special Achievement Award in Japan, presented by CGC Group chairman Atsuhiro Horiuchi, for making quality education accessible to children from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
payoff: The citation recognised Super 30's free IIT coaching and his Super Infinity initiative.
